title: Master test failure: BisectorTest.graphRingsAreAdoptedAsTheGraphsOwnSplinesAndStillEdit throws 'waypoint null' in RingTool.adoptGraphRings
description: On master 3549a4de (after CRAW-85 then CRAW-81 landed) the CRAW-85 test fails: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: waypoint 'null' needs three comma-separated coordinates, at SurfaceWaypoints.parse (SurfaceWaypoints.java:51) from RingTool.adoptGraphRings (RingTool.java:2061) from BisectorTest.java:737. It passed in the craw-85 worktree, so the combination with CRAW-81 (repair orientation) or a sync broke it. Find the root cause (which adopted ring reaches the parse path with no points, and why: a spline missing from the graph output so adoption falls back to tracing, a statement whose points field is absent, or the test fixture changed by the repair) and fix it at the source; the test must pass on master again, along with the full suite.
definition-of-done:
1. Root cause named.
2. BisectorTest and the full mvn test pass on master + the fix.
3. Live: IMG_4111 adoption still traces nothing (CRAW-85's timing holds).
changes-made: Cause: RingTool.adoptGraphRings read a spline_ring's normal with String.valueOf(inputSources.get(normal)), so a statement without a normal became the text "null" and SurfaceWaypoints.parse threw. CRAW-85's test strips the first ring's normal to cover the plane-fit branch, and in craw-85 that variant never ran: the final targeted run used -Dtest=A+B+C, which matched no tests (exit 0), and the full suite had run before the test edit. CRAW-81 is not involved. Fix: an absent normal argument is no normal (instanceof String, as mode already is). BisectorTest 16/16, mvn test 694/0; IMG_4111 adoption still 2 ms for 82 rings.
review-summary: RingTool's graph-ring adoption now reads a spline_ring statement's missing normal as no normal instead of parsing the text "null". A ring saved or written without a normal made adoption throw, which broke the CRAW-85 bisector test on master.
